expectation: Cytoplasmic/fibrous stain in a subset of stromal cells: smooth muscle rings around vessels, myofibroblast bands and pericyte lining in stroma, absent from lymphoid or tumour cell clusters and from nuclei.
observed: A: yellow forms ring-shaped vessel profiles and long fibrous bands and streaks across most images, with dark areas between them. B: parallel fibre-like strands in stroma. C: thick bands and vessel walls, with nucleus-dense blue regions left unstained. D: a curved, wall-like band.
why: SMA is confined to vessel-wall rings and fibrous stromal bands, and nucleus-dense regions stay unstained.
notes: Yellow outlines vessel rings and long stromal fibres and spares the cell-dense blue regions, as smooth muscle, myofibroblasts and pericytes should. B, C and D agree. The contrast is high and not diffuse.
